relationships.subject: Paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: PTX enhanced the expression of ionotropic purinergic receptor P2X7 (P2X7) in satellite glial cells (SGCs) and neurons in DRGs

relationships.subject: Trimethoxyflavanone
relationships.evidence_quote: Y3 reduced the PTX-enhanced P2X7 expression in DRGs

relationships.subject: Trimethoxyflavanone
relationships.evidence_quote: Y3 directly inhibited P2X7-mediated currents in DRG neurons of PTX-treated mice

relationships.subject: Trimethoxyflavanone
relationships.evidence_quote: Y3 also reduced the production of calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) in DRGs and at the spinal dorsal horn

key_findings: Y3 reverses PTX-induced pain by suppressing P2X7 expression/function and CGRP production
